item.title: Sanven Technology Recalls Vevor BMX Bicycles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard; Violate Federal Requirements for Bicycles
item.company: Vevorstores nationwide and online at www.vevor.com from October 2024 through April 2026 for between $152 and $188.
item.brand: Vevorstores nationwide and online at www.vevor.com from October 2024 through April 2026 for between $152 and $188.
item.summary: This recall involves Vevor-branded 20-inch and 24-inch BMX bicycles, models SS24001 and SS24002. The model numbers are printed on the product packaging. The bicycles were sold in black. The Vevor logo is printed across the downtube of the frame on the bikes.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Vevor BMX Bicycles.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the BMX bicycles immediately and contact Sanven Technology for a free repair kit. Consumers will be shipped free chain guards, with detailed installation tutorials and provided with after-sales support (such as customer service email) to help solve any issues arising during self-installation.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
